text: I You who dwell in the shelter of the Most High, [1]who abide in the shade of the Almighty, [2]
Say to the Lord, "My refuge and fortress,my God in whom I trust." [AA]
He will rescue you from the fowler's snare,from the destroying plague,
He will shelter you with his pinions,and under his wings you may take refuge; [AB]his faithfulness is a protecting shield.
You shall not fear the terror of the nightnor the arrow that flies by day, [AC]
Nor the pestilence that roams in darkness,nor the plague that ravages at noon. [AD]
Though a thousand fall at your side,ten thousand at your right hand,near you it shall not come.
You need simply watch;the punishment of the wicked you will see. [AE]
Because you have the Lord for your refugeand have made the Most High your stronghold,
No evil shall befall you,no affliction come near your tent. [AF]
t[3]For he commands his angels with regard to you, [AG]to guard you wherever you go. [AH]
With their hands they shall support you,lest you strike your foot against a stone. [AI]
You can tread upon the asp and the viper,trample the lion and the dragon. [AJ]
II Because he clings to me I will deliver him;because he knows my name I will set him on high. [AK]
He will call upon me and I will answer; [AL]I will be with him in distress; [AM]I will deliver him and give him honor.
With length of days I will satisfy him,and fill him with my saving power. [AN]
